cron_expression.title: Schedule
cron_expression.description: Cron schedule for producing the radar report (Europe/Amsterdam).

rss_database.title: RSS Database
rss_database.description: MongoDB database holding the curated RSS news corpus.

rss_collection.title: RSS Collection
rss_collection.description: MongoDB collection that stores the RSS feed entries.

max_items.title: Max Items Per Run
max_items.description: Maximum number of unread news items processed per run (cost/latency cap).

ai_model.title: Model
ai_model.description: The AI model used for theme finding and recoding.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of coding units sent to the model per batch.

quotes_per_theme.title: Quotes Per Theme
quotes_per_theme.description: Number of representative quotes surfaced per theme in the report.

research_objective.title: Research Objective
research_objective.description: Framing objective used for theme finding and report synthesis.
research_objective.default: Track what the AI/tech field is paying attention to — foundation models, AI agents, and agentic orchestration — and surface prominent themes plus emerging off-radar candidates worth investigating.

seed_codebook.title: Seed Codebook
seed_codebook.description: Curated codebook merged into the discovered themes; themes present here are reported as Covered, newly discovered themes as Emergent candidates. Provide the codebook as JSON text (a {"themes": [...]} object).

telegram_chat_id.title: Telegram Chat ID
telegram_chat_id.description: Telegram chat that receives the radar report file.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: When true, the report is produced and sent but processed items are NOT marked read (useful while iterating).
